# BTS ↔ Cursor Architecture Mapping v1 (MB-MAP-001)

## Goal
Map Cursor’s secure/incremental codebase indexing primitives 1:1 onto MetaBlooms components, then state where MetaBlooms must diverge (governance).

## Cursor primitives (observed)
- per-file SHA-256
- Merkle tree over workspace
- incremental sync
- similarity-based reuse
- access proof filtering

## 1:1 mapping
| Cursor | MetaBlooms |
|---|---|
| file hash | artifact node hash |
| workspace merkle root | merkle_root.json |
| incremental sync | build_merkle_index incremental mode |
| semantic/code search | retrieval over merkle nodes + domain coverage |
| reuse across workspaces | reuse_registry.json |
| access filtering | locator_registry + provenance proofs |

## Where BTS is better than Cursor
Cursor optimizes retrieval; BTS o
